hooks.command: python3 -c "import json,os,subprocess,sys,pathlib; p=json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); path=pathlib.Path(p).resolve() if p else None; root=pathlib.Path.cwd().resolve(); ok=bool(path) and path.suffix=='.py' and root in path.parents; ruff=root/'.venv/bin/ruff'; subprocess.run([str(ruff) if ruff.exists() else 'ruff','format','--quiet',str(path)],check=False) if ok else None"
